title: Autonomous Multi-Agent Scientific Research: A 361-Project Case Study in Thermoelectric Materials Discovery

contributions.purpose: 演示无人干预的大规模自主多智能体科研系统(规模)
contributions.mechanism: 8角色层级架构(President/Boss1/6 Workers)+100项目循环主题系统跑热电材料项目
contributions.evaluation: 执行361个项目,自称100%物理约束合规(0≤zT≤3.2),累积7500条RAG知识
contributions.source_quote: First autonomous system executing 361 complete research projects

contributions.purpose: 验证智能体故障后的系统韧性与恢复
contributions.mechanism: 记录v326 Boss1真实故障(重复请求)并触发Presidential override/隔离
contributions.evaluation: 故障期间维持92%运行能力,3次请求内自动检测,交付物保全
contributions.source_quote: Validated recovery from critical agent failures

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现的自主科研架构
contributions.mechanism: 模块化角色/决策协议/恢复机制+质量保证(25项checklist)
contributions.evaluation: 开源GitHub repo(MI_CC),声称可迁移至光伏/电池/催化
contributions.source_quote: Reproducible architecture for autonomous scientific discovery

self_declared_provenance.quote: based on a multi-agent platform developed from the Claude-Code-Communication framework [3]

notes: 重大数据可信度红旗:自认'complete metrics were not systematically captured',仅216/361(59.8%)有性能文档,仅2个项目有完整质量checklist(81.0/86.6),R²仅从44项目恢复且mean R²=0.124±2.63(近零/极差,范围−16.47~0.85)——核心'科学发现'被自身弱数据严重削弱,实为散落本地文件的占位结果。夸大语言('unprecedented scale'、'10×加速')无对照基线支撑(checklist自认baselines'will be reported once standardized logging is enforced')。AI披露:假设/分析/写作均[A]/系统自主。属规模+韧性工程演示而非可信科学产出;文中含重复句(如'This structure enables systematic learning across cycles'两次)。
